item.title: Alarming Outages and Technology Disruptions in America, Plus CNN’s Ridiculous Reporting on Dirty Bomb Threats | Ep. 1443 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly discusses the alarming outages and technology disruptions happening across America, what may be behind the growing problems, why it is time to take a closer look at the potential causes, the role AI and hackers could be playing, the alarming wave of banking and airline outages and disruptions, whether the public is being told the full story, what these growing technological vulnerabilities could mean for everyday Americans, CNN's ridiculous reporting on dirty bomb threats, their lack of accountability, former Vice President Mike Pence's comments on why Republicans lost the midterms, the continued push by neocon voices to escalate U.S. involvement in the Iran war regardless of midterm outcome,  Vice President JD Vance’s comments during an interview about the realistic timeline for U.S. involvement in the Iran war, the potential dangers of artificial intelligence, alarming statements from Anthropic’s CEO and Elon Musk about the future of AI, the risks these developments could pose, and more.
